hero.description: Prescriptions and diagnoses are written for doctors, not patients. Our assistant turns confusing medical text into plain language, then translates it into your regional language — so every patient understands their own care.

items.title: Plain-language simplification
items.description: Complex diagnoses and prescriptions are rewritten in everyday words, with every medical term explained.

items.title: Regional language translation
items.description: Simplified explanations are translated into Hindi, Marathi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, and more.

items.title: Prescription scanning
items.description: Photograph or upload a prescription and let the assistant read and process it automatically.

items.title: Personal medical history
items.description: Every simplified, translated record is saved to your profile, so you can revisit past visits anytime.

steps.title: Upload your prescription
steps.description: Take a photo or upload a PDF of your prescription or medical report.

steps.title: We simplify the medical text
steps.description: Our model rewrites the jargon into clear, everyday language.

steps.title: Choose your language
steps.description: Select your regional language for the translated explanation.

steps.title: Read and understand
steps.description: View your simplified, translated report — and keep it saved for later.

items.q: Is my medical information kept private?
items.a: Yes. Your prescriptions and reports are only used to generate your simplified, translated summary and are not shared with anyone else.
Hindi, Marathi, Tamil, Telugu, and Kannada are supported at launch, with more regional languages planned.

items.q: Do I need internet access to use this?
items.a: Yes, an internet connection is currently required to process and translate your documents.

items.q: Can a health worker use this on behalf of a patient?
items.a: Yes. ASHA workers and clinic staff can upload documents and share the simplified explanation with patients directly.
